target: real built Windows DockSlate WebView2 window with stopped independent runtime
changes: Renderer reload, menu/tab navigation, real CDP pointer drags, read-only VHDX prerequisites and a canceled elevation confirmation. One explicit unapproved elevation request verifies rejection. No engine/data/disk changes or operating-system windows are requested.
measurement: Actual IPC POST command names/timestamps and wsl_preview response bodies are observed through CDP. No requests, response values, backend functions or routing are replaced. Text selection uses actual Input.dispatchMouseEvent drags.

checks.name: the real stopped independent runtime loads through one global snapshot
actual mouse drags across the title, subtitle and active navigation select no app-chrome text
Docker Hub search is visible without opening Pull, remains disabled while disconnected and navigation performs no automatic reads
real prerequisite rows match live ownership, stopped state, permission and disk-tool diagnostics and provide enabled remedies
actual VHDX paths and real prerequisite diagnostics remain selectable with a mouse drag
inspection retry performs only one actual read-only wsl_preview
elevation confirmation describes impact, requires acknowledgement and cancels without launch; backend rejects approved:false and preserves the original UI
stopped Settings has neutral state, a Disconnected header, retained diagnostics and no stale success banner or actual system changes

confirmation.text:
관리자 권한으로 다시 실행

현재 실행 중인 DockSlate를 관리자 권한으로 다시 엽니다. Windows 권한 요청이 표시됩니다.

새 창이 열리면 현재 창을 닫습니다. 검색과 선택한 항목은 초기화되며 엔진 상태와 저장된 데이터는 유지됩니다.

디스크 검사와 압축은 새 창에서 직접 실행합니다.

대상과 영향을 확인했으며 이 작업을 승인합니다.
